_note: Pre-registered 2026-11-03, BEFORE any pairs data was downloaded or any result existed. Do not edit to fit a result. To change a criterion, add a dated entry to docs/research/log.md saying why, then edit.
idea: Dollar-neutral pairs trading on daily closes: when the log price ratio of two same-industry stocks or ETFs stretches, short the rich leg and buy the cheap one, exit when it reverts. Sources: Gatev, Goetzmann and Rouwenhorst (NBER w7032); Do and Faff 2010 and 2012 (profits declined, and after costs and short fees are modest or largely gone outside turbulent periods; search summaries, papers not read). Expectation stated up front: a FAIL is the likely outcome.
pair_selection: Fixed now by economic rationale (same industry or same asset class), not by any backtest. Rule for data: a pair is dropped only if either leg has fewer than 15 years of daily history on IBKR, and the dropped pairs are listed in the log. If fewer than 6 pairs remain, the test is reported as inconclusive, not as pass or fail.

rule.spread: log(close A) - log(close B), hedge ratio fixed at 1 (equal dollars per leg, no fitted beta)
rule.zscore: (spread - mean of last W days) / std of last W days, using closes through day t only
rule.enter: z > E: short A and buy B. z < -E: buy A and short B
rule.exit: |z| < 0.5, or |z| > 4.0 (stop), or 30 trading days held (time stop)
rule.fill: signal at close t, filled at close t+1
rule.sizing: total capital 100,000 split equally across pairs; each leg is half of the pair's capital; whole shares
rule.costs: tempo.backtest.Costs defaults on every order, both legs
rule.borrow: 0.3% a year on the market value of shorts, accrued daily (assumed; IBKR notes short credit interest can offset some of it and rates can change intraday). Sensitivity run at 1.5%.

variants_tried.note: Only the primary can pass. The other four are a fragility check and are all reported.

negative_control: 200 versions with the same random permutation of days applied to all assets (keeps each asset's returns and the correlations, destroys mean reversion of the spread).
pass_all_of: primary portfolio (equal weight of the surviving pairs) net Sharpe >= 0.5 at 0.3% borrow
primary beats at least 95% of the shuffled controls on Sharpe
primary Sharpe > 0 in both halves of the sample
at least 4 of the 5 variants have Sharpe > 0
absolute correlation of the portfolio's daily returns with SPY below 0.3 (the market-neutral claim)
at least 60% of the individual pairs have positive net P&L (not one lucky pair)
if_fail: Report it as a failure. No retuning, no extra variants, no dropping pairs after seeing results.
if_pass: Still not proof of an edge: next step is shadow mode and paper trading per evidence/gate.json. Not real money.
